biotools.summary: CalliCog is an open-source cognitive neuroscience toolkit designed for experiments with freely behaving nonhuman primates, specifically marmosets. It provides modular operant chambers and integrates seamlessly with home cages, enabling automated cognitive testing and simultaneous neural recordings.
